name: Chess
description: Chess for two: the host plays one side on the board, the assistant the other through commands. Full rules, with illegal moves refused.

state.help: the game: whose turn, check/checkmate/stalemate/draw, the board, FEN, moves played and every legal move

legalMoves.help: the legal moves for the side to move, or only those from one square (e2)

move.help: play a move as UCI (e2e4, e7e8q) or SAN (Nf3, O-O); pass side to refuse it when it is not that side's turn

newGame.help: start again from the opening position; hostSide is the side the window plays (white by default)

loadFen.help: set up a position from a FEN, for testing a rule; the game starts from it

replay.help: show the whole game move by move in the board window (delayMs per half-move, 1000 by default), then return to the live position; changes nothing

previousGames.help: the last five games a new game or loadFen replaced, newest first, as PGN with their result

stopReplay.help: stop a running replay and show the live position again

resign.help: resign the game for one side (white or black)

moves.help: one line per move played, new game or position set
